profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Focused, inquisitive computer science graduate with a strong background in object-oriented programming. Seeking a full-time position that will allow me to utilize my problem-solving skills on real-world applications and advance my abilities in the computer science field.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Great River, New York, United States

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: I worked as a Teaching Assistant for Data Structures and Compiler Construction courses, teaching a weekly recitation, holding office hours, and grading papers for 120 students. Each of these classes had a lab section that I oversaw, answering questions and clearly communicating the core concepts of the assignment to the students. Throughout the week I met with students, providing feedback on their work and offering guidance on how to improve their software skills.

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description: I interned at the Vatican City as part of a study abroad/work study program, developing panoramic photos of Castel Gandolfo for the museum’s online 3D virtual tours. I assisted the collection of photos from the premises and generated dozens of panoramas using the KRpano and PTGui software. Each panorama was created from over 100 pictures that I stitched together to ensure the final result was of high quality. Unfortunately, due to COVID travel restrictions, I was forced to leave the country and was unable to continue my position.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked with a university professor, Dr. Vijay Gehlot, on modeling the workflow of a hospital operating room to demonstrate the uses and efficacy of simulation technology in the healthcare field. I designed a colored petri net to model the healthcare staff, rooms, and resources of a hospital system, along with the actions and steps necessary for routine surgical procedures. I then analyzed and improved efficiencies within the model, demonstrating how a hospital could use the findings to create a more streamlined process in their own network. These findings will be published and presented at the 2021 Winter Simulation Conference.
